card.name: Section names in 'see' cross-references
card.fires_on: The section title word right after 'see' or 'see Clinical' inside a bracketed cross-reference, mainly 'Description' and 'Studies', just before the section number in parentheses.

modes.label: Description reference
modes.description: The word Description in a bracketed 'see Description (11)' pointer.

modes.label: Clinical Studies reference
modes.description: The word Studies after 'see Clinical' in a pointer to section 14.

modes.label: Other stray cases
modes.description: A rare hyphenated word start in running text, such as single-dose.

card.plain: It marks the section name in a 'see Description' or 'see Clinical Studies' pointer in a drug label.
